accepted.quote: The majority wishes to enact a piece of legislation whose primary goal has already been accomplished. For the reasons stated above, I oppose this legislation.
accepted.bill: H.R. 3015, the National Coal Council Reestablishment Act
accepted.rationale: The legislator explicitly states opposition to H.R. 3015 because its goal of reestablishing the National Coal Council has already been accomplished.

new_issues.name: National Coal Council and Coal Advisory Policy
